description: This file is a JavaScript script for analyzing Node.js native addon files, particularly those with the '.node' extension. It recursively traverses directories to identify and determine whether each native addon module uses N-API by invoking external tools ('nm' on UNIX or 'dumpbin' on Windows) and processing their output.

methods.name: checkFile(file, command, argv, reducer)
methods.description: Spawns a child process to run a command that inspects a native addon file to determine if it uses N-API, analyzes the output line by line using a reducer function, and logs whether the file is an N-API module or not.

methods.name: checkFileUNIX(file)
methods.description: Uses the 'nm' command to list symbols in a '.node' file on UNIX systems, and processes the output to detect if the file is an N-API module based on symbol names starting with 'napi'.

methods.name: checkFileWin32(file)
methods.description: Uses the 'dumpbin' utility to list imported symbols in a '.node' file on Windows systems, and processes the output to identify if the file is an N-API module.

methods.name: recurse(top)
methods.description: Recursively traverses a directory structure starting from a given top directory, identifying '.node' files (excluding 'nothing.node') and invoking platform-specific checks to determine if each is an N-API module.
